entrypoint: checkModule(module, obligations = [], limits?) -> Check with complete full violation set, resourceFailure, facts and destinations; old exact types/scopes/diagnostics/complete projections retained
obligation_storage: DocumentState.slotObligations readonly array; immutable copy/remap/retention by owning slot address. Never add sidecar to Module/DraftModule wire fields. candidate(state) serializes only existing known Module fields.
key: JSON.stringify([ownerId, role, rule, expectedFacts, actualFacts, relatedIds]); ordered canonical fact arrays; no display text; different left/right/argument positions and exact nominal lists distinct.
pre_replace_capture: Integration obtains destination owning slot from before module, captures hole.expected if destination is hole, combines existing slot obligations, then remaps candidate-side slot owner addresses. Preserve these into next immutable state even if replacement is incomplete. Do not persist previous concrete expression inferred type.
transaction_signature: newContradiction(before, after, beforeObligations=[], afterObligations=beforeObligations) compares checkModule results; resourceFailure on either side rejects. Same-parent keys and all errors beyond64 are enforced.
display: Existing slotConstraints(module, checked) adapter consumes checked.destinations; parent descriptions may retain existing text. Root callers pass state.slotObligations to checkModule.
partial_schema: At most8 shapes, one for each possible width1..8; per-column exact ID or null. This enumerates widths only, never nominal schema assignments. Sort is independent of shapes. Known width/endpoint/columns constrain shapes; empty relation shape set is violation, never unresolved success.
